C9000350.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 350 (Yau’s nodal bounds: surfaces and higher dimensions.; papers: Sharp nodal length on smooth surfaces; Smooth counterexamples to Yau's nodal upper bound in dimensions three and four; Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/350.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_SURFACE.statement: For every fixed smooth closed connected Riemannian surface, all nonzero real eigenfunctions with positive eigenvalue have nodal length at most C times sqrt(lambda).

C_QUALITATIVE.statement: The staged qualitative manuscript constructs fixed smooth metrics on S^3 arbitrarily C-infinity close to round and on S^2 times T^2 with eigenfunction sequences having unbounded nodal measure divided by sqrt(lambda).

C_POWER_NODAL.statement: One fixed smooth metric on S^4 times S^1 has eigenfunction nodal measure growing faster than lambda^(1/2+epsilon_0) for a fixed epsilon_0>0.

C_POWER_DOWNSTREAM.statement: The power-law wave, sign-certificate, exactification, spectral-persistence, limiting-pair and warped-circle arguments preserve a common positive gain exponent.

C_SEED.statement: Lemma lem:seed supplies a uniform positive-test seed and a nonzero-gradient positive-Hessian initial region for nearby C^1 metrics.

C_LOCAL_HESSIAN.statement: The corrugation has a uniform positive Hessian test including zero cutoff/well coefficients and arbitrarily small or large positive parent slopes.

C_MASS_SELECTION.statement: A fixed finite radial-well pattern and closed-child selection yield repeat preparation and selected gradient mass strictly greater than the entire old parent mass.

C_CORRUGATION.statement: Lemma lem:corrugation holds with all stated preparation, support, derivative, metric and order-of-choices quantifiers.

C_ENVELOPE.statement: Proposition prop:envelope holds with one positive power-gain exponent independent of every later finite approximation order.

C_ITERATION.statement: Additive increment estimates give one linear-in-order exponential growth constant, a persistent Hessian margin, and an accuracy-independent positive envelope gain.

C_CONVEX_AMPLIFICATION.statement: For every fixed base dimension n>=4, one pattern preserves every corrugation condition and selects gradients uniformly larger than the maximum old parent gradient, simultaneously amplifying every real r>=1 moment and every finite nonnegative convex energy Phi with Phi(0)=0; the same logarithmic iteration gives order-independent moment exponents.
